senses.definition_en: fried egg

examples.english: Fried eggs are opened and dropped into a hot grease such as lard or butter. Scrambled eggs are beaten before frying.
examples.ref: 1914, Guillermo Franklin Hall Aviles, All Spanish method, first[-second book] método directo para aprender el español, page 287:
examples.text: Los huevos estrellados se abren y dejan caer en una grasa caliente como la manteca o la mantequilla. Los huevos revueltos se baten antes de ponerlos a freír.
examples.translation: Fried eggs are opened and dropped into a hot grease such as lard or butter. Scrambled eggs are beaten before frying.

examples.english: […] one for frying the tortillas slightly, without hardening, one by one, and the other to make fried eggs […]
examples.text: […] uno para freír las tortillas ligeramente, sin que se endurezcan, de una en una, y el otro para hacer los huevos estrellados […]
examples.translation: […] one for frying the tortillas slightly, without hardening, one by one, and the other to make fried eggs […]

examples.english: If you follow these instructions carefully you will have some pretty fried eggs with clear curd and the yolk whole.
examples.ref: 2002, Chepina Peralta, Cocina para la recién casada, page 36:
examples.text: Si sigues cuidadosamente estas instrucciones te quedarán unos lindos huevos estrellados con la clara cuajada y la yema entera.
examples.translation: If you follow these instructions carefully you will have some pretty fried eggs with clear curd and the yolk whole.

glosses: fried egg
